content.short: DackieSwap is a multichain DEX with AI agent features, deployed on Unichain and World Chain.
content.description: DackieSwap is a multichain decentralized exchange that has added AI agent features alongside standard swapping and liquidity provision. It is deployed on Unichain and World Chain, and appears in Alchemy's ecosystem directory for World Chain. It tends to launch early on newer L2s, where smaller DEXes can build share before liquidity consolidates.
